notes.title: Update 1.8 released!
notes.notes:
After several months of testing and bug fixing, update [b]1.8[/b] is now live! Here is a summary of the most important changes:

[h1]Bricks[/h1]

[h2]Spinner Brick[/h2]

The new spinner brick is a whole new type of scalable. It allows youto create arches and circles at custom angles, radii, sizes andshapes.

[img]https://fluppisoft.com/assets/spinner-bricks/spinner-demo.gif[/img]

[h2]Scalable Flaps[/h2]

Flaps are now also scalable. So instead of two different flaps sizes,there is now a virtually infinite amount of them.

[img]https://fluppisoft.com/assets/scalable-flaps/working-flaps.gif[/img]

[h2]Scalable Thrusters[/h2]

Thrusters are finally fully scalable! I’m pretty excited about thismyself, and it has been requested by the community for years.

[img]https://fluppisoft.com/assets/update-1-8/scalable-thrusters.gif[/img]

Along with that, they also received a new heat glow effect for thenozzle.

[img]https://fluppisoft.com/assets/update-1-8/thruster-glow.gif[/img]

Old non-scalable thrusters are automatically replaced with scalable thrusters upon loading a vehicle. The input scale is adjusted so the thrust remains the same as before.

[h2]More Scalables[/h2]

Besides thrusters and flaps, all of the following bricks are now scalable:
[list][*]Fuel tanks[/*][*]Detonators[/*][*]RC bricks[/*][*]Math bricks[/*][*]Sensor bricks[/*][*]Switch bricks[/*][/list]

[h2]Exhaust Trail Effect[/h2]

Exhaust bricks now have a setting to select the desired effect. Sofar there is the old smoke effect along with a new trail effect.

[img]https://fluppisoft.com/assets/update-1-8/exhaust-effects.gif[/img]

[h2]Camera and Seat Names andOrder[/h2]

The display names and order of cameras and seats can now becustomized in the editor. The custom names will be displayed wheninteracting with a seat or cycling through camera modes for example. Theorder in which you could cycle through seats and cameras was sort ofrandom previously. Now you can see and customize it.

[h2]New Sensor Modes[/h2]

The following new sensor modes were added:
[list][*]Frames per second[/*][*]Frame delta time (1 / frames per second)[/*][*]Time of day[/*][*]Wind speed anddirection[/*][*]Altitude over sea level[/*][/list]

[h1]User Interface[/h1][h2]Color Properties[/h2]
Color properties received a bit of an overhaul, both on the outsideand inside. Previously, color was stored and saved in HSV (hue, value,saturation) format. Now it’s using the more common 8 bit RGB (red,green, blue) format, which makes it possible to show and enter precisehex color values. Along with that you can now also switch the slidersbetween RGB and HSV mode.

[img]https://fluppisoft.com/assets/update-1-8/color-property.gif[/img]

[h2]Numeric Properties[/h2]

Internally, float properties, vector properties and brick sizeproperties were all merged into the same type. This streamlines code aswell as the user interfaces and allows features to be shared betweenthem more easily. For example, axes of all multidimensional propertiescan now be locked together, and you can toggle between brick units andmeters on all distance based properties.

[img]https://fluppisoft.com/assets/update-1-8/numeric-properties.gif[/img]

[h1]Miscellaneous Improvements[/h1]

[list][*]Made vehicle spawning asynchronous to reduce multiplayerhitches[/*][*]Increased precision of output channel values[/*][*]Added fire mode switching for handheld guns[/*][*]Added Newton thrust slider to thrusters[/*][*]Added experimental HDR support[/*][*]Added ability to move sliders more precisely or faster by holdingcontrol or shift[/*][/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list][*]Fixed menu music randomly stopping after a while[/*][*]Fixed vehicle whitelist not being loaded correctly when launchinggamec[/*][*]Fixed redirector 1x1x1 mesh being rotated 180°, making connectorsnot match up correctly[/*][*]Fixed UI scale affecting mini map resolution[/*][*]Fixed actuators no resetting position after repairing inmultiplayer[/*][*]Fixed inaccurate collision and mass properties on scalablecylinders[/*][*]Fixed tank tracks not reappearing on clients after repairing[/*][*]Fixed changing frame rate limit not activating the apply button[/*][/list]

[list]
[*] Made wheels, text bricks, image bricks, lights and exhausts [b]scalable[/b]

[*] Fixed item container on canyon battle overlapping with truck wreck
[*] Fixed brick count of spawned legacy vehicles being shown as zero in chat messages

[*] Fixed bricks sometimes being culled on vehicle thumbnail captures
[*] Fixed Bob spawning above or below the custom exit location
[*] Fixed not being able to update the name of banned players

notes.title: Patch 1.6.2 released!

UI:
[list]
[*] Fixed match settings in host menu not being divided into categories
[*] Added option to only allow public Workshop items to be spawned as an alternative to whitelists
[*] Added context menu to chat messages, which allows kicking as well as viewing the associated vehicle in the Steam overlay

[/list]

Editor:
[list]
[*] Manually entered brick location and rotation should not change after committing the move anymore
[*] Fixed dead zone in brick rotation at around 90° of pitch

[*] Fixed crash when copying output channel bricks
[*] Leave the original brick selected when mirror copying if mirror mode is enabled

[list]
[*] Fixed issues with config exporting and importing, causing the vehicle whitelist not being saved correctly for example
[*] Fixed heat seeking projectiles targeting the own vehicle
[*] Improved handling of corrupt vehicle files, should now output an error instead half loading, freezing or crashing
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.5 and End of Early Access
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Update 1.5 has been released to the main branch today, and with it, Brick Rigs will be transitioning from [b]Early Access to a full release[/b] on Steam. After almost 8 years of development, the game is finally in a state where I feel comfortable taking this step. And don’t worry, Brick Rigs will still be getting updates with new content and fixes after the release!

Oh, and here are the most important changes of this update:
[list]
[*] Improved UI design
[*] Better gamepad and keyboard support for the UI
[*] New math and seven segment display bricks
[*] Improved input channel system (no longer limited to 256 channels)
[*] Greatly increased maximum explosion size
[*] Many more small fixes and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Update Time
notes.notes:
After almost 2 years of development the [b]biggest and most important update[/b] so far is finally finished. Almost the entire game as been rewritten from scratch to [b]improve almost every aspect of the game[/b]. A list of all the changes and new features would be way too long, just hop into the game and see for yourself.

I recommend using the [b]input help[/b] menu to learn about the new keybinds and features, just hold the escape key in game to access it.

If you are having trouble transitioning to the new version of Brick Rigs or feel nostalgic you will be able to continue playing the old version as a beta branch on Steam (Brick Rigs -> Properties -> Betas -> Legacy).

notes.title: Performance Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

This update focuses mainly on optimization, bug fixes as well as other small improvements. Since some core mechanics had to be tweaked, there may be some new bugs and issues. Please report them on the Discord server or in the Steam discussions so they can be fixed as soon as possible.

Here are the most notable changes:
-Improved rendering performance (courtesy to Unreal Engine 4.21)
-Much smoother spawning, collisions, repairing and removing of vehicles
-Increased maximum file size for spawning custom vehicles in multiplayer
-Reworked lighting and post processing for better performance and better visuals
-Vehicles block explosions against players
-Added cyrillic letters for nameplate bricks
-Added round image bricks
-Smoke and dust particles now fade out nicely when entering a new surface type, instead of disappearing immediatelly
-Conquest flags are now displayed as green (own team) and red (other team)
-Disabled spawning at conquest flags that are being captured

notes.title: UI Update
notes.notes:

- Fixed silo breaking on the desert map

Fixes:

notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

In this update the multiplayer mode got some love and should work drastically better now. Most importantly the size limit for custom vehicles has been raised and the vehicle data is further compressed for networking, the result is that custom vehicles in multiplayer can now be about 10x bigger than before.

Multiplayer:
- Custom vehicle size limit raised and vehicle files now compressed (size limit can be tweaked in config files)
- Host can set the max number of bricks a vehicle may have
- Improved physics networking, vehicles glitching out should be far less common

Improvements:
- Explosions within a vehicle are combined for better performance and bigger destruction (few tanks or thrusters cause less destruction than before but many of them can form a massive explosion)
- Pump brick can now be used to extinguish fire

Bug fixes:
- Fixed siren 2 not looping
- Fixed crash when entering a vehicle in free cam mode

Known issues:
- Vehicles where large parts are connected with actuators or couplings can still glitch out

notes.title: Editor Update
notes.notes:
This update features a couple of improvements for Vehicle Editor, as well as other new features.

Editor:
- New free camera movement, controlled with they WASDEQ keys while holding down the right mouse button. Press F to snap the camera to the current selection
- Bricks can be moved faster up and down by holding left Shift while scrolling
- Improved outline: Outline is not x-ray anymore but culled by not select bricks in front of it. Line between active and selected bricks is always drawn. This should make it easier to see what is selected and where it is in the 3D space
- When a Workshop vehicle is not already downloaded via Steam, it will be automatically downloaded when opening it in the editor

Other:
- New "Rounded Corner" brick (Zylinders or Bricks category)
- Fixed bricks receiving view yaw or pitch input while holding the right mouse button to interact

Last but not least: Since so many new players have problems to find the reverse gear, vehicles now automatically shift into reverse when braking and standing still. I have to admit that it now indeed feels much more fluent and intuitive. The old system is still in use for the manual transmission mode.

notes.title: First update in 2017
notes.notes:
Hello!

This first update in 2017 brings a couple of new bricks and improvements that should be a lot of fun for builders and drivers alike.
The main change that you will notice is that motors behave singificantly different. Vehicles should now accelerate properly even when they are very heavy or driving up steep slopes.
This change should turn offroading into a viable option, which you can test for yourself for example with the new 8x8 offroad truck on the desert map!

Bricks:
- Added passenger seats
- New custom nameplate bricks in various sizes
- New diesel V12 engine
- New 20x1x1s linear actuator
- New double sided ramps
- New trapezoid brick
- Various new standard bricks
- Fixed collision on siren

Multiplayer:
- Map name and player count displayed in server browser
- Host can kick players in the scoreboard now

Other:
- New engine physics, less physically accurate, more powerful
- Removed outdated default vehicles and added new ones
- In game menu can be exited with Escape key
- Actuator movement with interaction is replicated now
